name: The Netherite Age
pages: The {b}Netherite Age{/} is the end-game stage of Create: Genesis. From the time a player reaches {b}the End{/} dimension, they are in this stage.{pb}Accessing the End unlocks new content for players to obtain more powerful items, such as {i}netherite gear{/}, craftable {i}spawners{/}, {i}elytra{/}, and {i}pale gold amulets{/}.

In order to reach the End, you will need {i}eyes of ender{/} to locate a stronghold and open its End portal.{pb}An {i}eye of ender{/} can only be obtained by crafting an {i}inert eye of ender{/} using valuable resources from the Overworld and Nether, and then using {k:use/k} on {i}reinforced deepslate{/} with the eye in your hand to activate it. Place an {i}eye of ender{/} on each {i}end portal frame{/} to open the portal.
Items that can be {b}obtained{/} in the Natherite Age have {b}blue tooltip borders{/}.
